title: Farm app endpoint inventory and implementation contract
note: Not an OpenAPI document. Generate actual OpenAPI from FastAPI/Pydantic in the implementation.
rules: Every authenticated mutation requires session and CSRF verification.
Path farm_id is checked against current enabled membership.
Safe DTOs never serialize password_hash, session hashes, or provider secrets.
No async job status, audit, view, event, or message endpoints.

endpoints.function: Liveness check without sensitive configuration.
Verify credentials and issue a new cookie session.
endpoints.outputs: AuthResult: safe user, enabled memberships with farm summaries, csrf_token, password-change requirement; Set-Cookie header

endpoints.function: Restore frontend identity and current memberships.
endpoints.outputs: AuthResult; no password hash or raw session token

endpoints.function: Revoke current session and clear cookie.
Verify current password; change hash; revoke old sessions and rotate current one.
Read current farm.
endpoints.outputs: Farm: id, name, timezone, created_at, updated_at

endpoints.function: Edit farm name/timezone.
Load role-specific initialization data.
endpoints.inputs: optional local_date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to farm-local today
endpoints.outputs: user, farm, membership, fields, activities, fertilizers, own scheduled shifts; admins also get worker filter options and tags

endpoints.function: List employees and admins.
Create a new user and farm membership atomically.
endpoints.outputs: safe Member and temporary_password returned once

endpoints.function: Change role or farm access; protect last admin.
Reset an eligible farm-confined worker account.
List field metadata for settings and selection.
Load field polygons for maps.
endpoints.outputs: GeoJSON FeatureCollection with next_cursor; top-level farm_bbox

endpoints.function: Read one field including boundary.
Create field from supplied boundary.
endpoints.inputs: name, geometry: Polygon or MultiPolygon GeoJSON

endpoints.function: Edit field name and/or geometry.
Delete only an unreferenced field.
List task vocabulary.
List fertilizer vocabulary.
Create task type, not a scheduled task instance.
Create fertilizer category/product.
Rename a task type.
Rename a fertilizer category/product.
Delete only an unreferenced task type.
Delete only an unreferenced fertilizer category/product.
Read planned schedule with interval-overlap filtering.
Create a scheduled assignment.
endpoints.inputs: employee_id, start_at, end_at, field_id:null|UUID, activity_id:null|UUID, fertilizer_id:null|UUID, fertilizer_id:null|UUID

endpoints.function: Edit planned assignment; preserve referenced identity.
endpoints.inputs: start_at?, end_at?, field_id?, activity_id?, fertilizer_id?; employee_id change only if unreferenced

endpoints.function: Delete an unreferenced scheduled assignment.
endpoints.outputs: no body; 409 if linked to a log

endpoints.function: Mint short-lived voice credential using fixed server instructions.
endpoints.inputs: optional own shift_id; no arbitrary model/instructions
endpoints.outputs: client_secret, expires_at, configured model, interview_version; no permanent provider key

endpoints.function: Persist immutable recording metadata and transcript before AI work.
endpoints.outputs: RecordingReceipt: id, recorded_at, uploaded_at, linked_log_id; 200 on identical retry

endpoints.function: Recover recording receipt/details after interrupted submission.
endpoints.outputs: RecordingDetail, including transcript and computed linked_log_id

endpoints.function: Create or renew restricted direct-upload authorization.
endpoints.inputs: empty body; reject if already confirmed

endpoints.function: Verify S3 object, pin version, and record upload receipt.
endpoints.outputs: RecordingReceipt with uploaded_at set; repeat is safe

endpoints.function: Synchronously generate and persist a report from a confirmed recording.
Reusable filtered query for dashboard, activity/fertilizer grid, map sidebar, and history.
Read full report without creating a view/read event.
endpoints.outputs: LogDetail with summary, answers, transcript, recording metadata, tags, field geometry, and scheduled shift

endpoints.function: Authorize temporary browser playback of the pinned private recording.
Return explicit dashboard metrics and the first filtered report page.
endpoints.inputs: LogFilters; no cursor; initial limit default 25
endpoints.outputs: DashboardResult: as_of, timezone, metrics, metric_scopes, logs

endpoints.function: Read farm tag catalog.
Create a tag.
Attach an existing same-farm tag idempotently.
endpoints.outputs: updated list of tags on the log
